# Identify influential observations

<small>Source: [`man/performInfluenceDiagnostics.Rd`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/man/performInfluenceDiagnostics.Rd) · Help: `?performInfluenceDiagnostics`</small>

Uses Cook's distance to flag influential observations.

## Usage

```r
performInfluenceDiagnostics(model, cutoff = NULL)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   A fitted `lm` model.

`cutoff`
:   Cook's distance threshold; defaults to `4/(n - p)`.

## Value

A list with Cook's distances and indices of influential points.

## Examples

```r
data(mtcars)
m <- lm(mpg ~ wt + qsec, data = mtcars)
performInfluenceDiagnostics(m)
```
